description: This file defines an Android Fragment responsible for editing or creating tasks in a to-do list application. It manages user input, interacts with a ViewModel, and handles UI actions such as save, delete, and loading task details.

classes.name: EditTaskFragment
classes.description: Android Fragment for editing or creating tasks with UI interactions and ViewModel integration.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment to its context, initializing the Listener if the context implements it.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel and retrieves task ID argument if provided.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout using View Binding.

methods.name: validateTitle
methods.description: Validates that the task title input is not empty; provides error if invalid.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI elements, event handlers, and loads existing task data if editing.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the fragment with optional task ID argument for editing.
